title: Restless For No Clear Reason?
caption: Wired and worn out? Energy may jump and dip today, so do short bursts of work and tuck in a minute or two of slow breathing between tasks to steady the pace.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity is on the active side and the background resonance is a notch livelier than usual. Solar activity sent a few flares and several CMEs in the last day. Overall tone feels unsettled, like your nervous system is getting small pings.
affects: You may notice bursts of restlessness and trouble settling into a steady rhythm. Energy might spike and drop more quickly for some. Sleep can feel fragmented if you don’t protect your evening routine.
playbook:
- Pause every 30–60 minutes for one to three minutes of slow breathing
- Swap long tasks for short ones and add easy movement breaks
- Dim screens and lights an hour before bedtime
- Stay hydrated and skip heavy late caffeine

fb.caption: Body buzzing for no clear reason? You’re not imagining the jitter—things in space have been lively and that can make some of us feel wired and tired at the same time. Active geomagnetic conditions plus a few recent flares and CMEs tend to nudge the nervous system toward quick shifts: sprinty moments, then a crash. That looks like short bursts of focus, more startles, or trouble settling in the evening. Slow down the transitions where you can: shorter tasks, a soft movement break, and lighter evening screens help the body resettle. If you’re sensitive, keep plans flexible and let pauses be normal instead of rare. Gaia Eyes: notice the pattern, pace gently, and treat your nervous system like a neighbor—friendly, not loud.
